story.title: Story 5: Reopen and Degraded Provenance States

result.planSummary: Fixed the stale package-member selection regression by wiring `selectPackageMember()` to reuse the review-workspace reload fallback on `PACKAGE_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` and `REVIEW_TARGET_NOT_FOUND`, then added a client regression test proving the package stays visible with bounded degraded state instead of collapsing the workspace.

changedFiles.reason: Added workspace-reload fallback handling for stale package-member selection failures so bounded degraded package state is restored instead of patching a fatal workspace error.
Added client regression coverage for stale package-member selection fallback and bounded degraded package rendering.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/service/client/package-member-nav.test.ts --environment jsdom

findingsFixed: Wired stale package-member selection failures through the same workspace-reload fallback pattern already used for stale artifact-version selections, preserving bounded degraded package state for `PACKAGE_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` and `REVIEW_TARGET_NOT_FOUND`.
Added client regression coverage to prove stale package-member selection no longer collapses the review workspace into `reviewWorkspace.error`.
findingsSurfaced: Repo-level `test:e2e` remains scaffold-only, so verification evidence for this story still tops out at unit/service/client/integration coverage plus the passing `green-verify` and `verify-all` gates.

specDeviations: PlatformStore still owns part of the review/package composition surface through `listProcessReviewTargets` and `getProcessReviewPackage` instead of the fully narrowed durable-facts-only boundary described in the Epic 5 server tech design.
result.recommendedNextStep: Return this story to verification and have the verifier re-check SV-05-001 against the new stale package-member fallback behavior.
